title: KHR_character_expression_joint KHR_character_expression Extension
description: Classifies selected expression-animation channels as ordinary core node-TRS channels.

channels.description: Nonempty array of unique indices classifying ordinary core node-TRS channels. Classification does not select or filter channels for base expression evaluation.

items.description: Index of a classified channel in the expression entry's selected animation.
items.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the `channels` array of the animation selected by the containing expression entry's `animation` property. The channel MUST use an ordinary core target with a node and path `translation`, `rotation`, or `scale`; the node MUST NOT define `matrix`.
